description: This file contains helper functions related to database abstraction, SQL modification, data type probing, and debugging utilities for the ADOdb PHP library. It includes functions for manipulating SQL queries, preparing data types, quoting identifiers, and executing debug routines.

methods.name: adodb_strip_order_by
methods.description: Removes the ORDER BY clause from an SQL SELECT statement, if present, ensuring it doesn't affect subqueries.

methods.name: adodb_probetypes
methods.description: Guesses data types of array entries (e.g., for database import/export) based on sample data.

methods.name: adodb_transpose
methods.description: Transposes a 2D array, optionally extracting headers.

methods.name: _adodb_replace
methods.description: Generates an UPDATE or INSERT SQL statement for a given table and data array.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu
methods.description: Builds HTML SELECT element options for a dropdown menu from a dataset.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu_gp
methods.description: Builds grouped HTML SELECT options with optgroups.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu_select
methods.description: Creates the opening HTML SELECT tag with attributes based on parameters.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu_option
methods.description: Generates an OPTION tag for a SELECT menu, marking it as selected if appropriate.

methods.name: _adodb_getcount
methods.description: Calculates the number of records a SQL query will return, using query rewriting heuristics.

methods.name: _adodb_pageexecute_all_rows
methods.description: Executes a paginated query with total record count and returns a result set with pagination info.

methods.name: _adodb_pageexecute_no_last_page
methods.description: Executes a paginated query without knowing the total number of pages, useful for infinite scroll.

methods.name: _adodb_quote_fieldname
methods.description: Quotes and optionally converts the case of a field name for database queries.

methods.name: _adodb_getupdatesql
methods.description: Creates an UPDATE SQL statement based on differences in recordset and data array.

methods.name: adodb_key_exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in an array, considering null and empty string cases based on force parameter.

methods.name: _adodb_getinsertsql
methods.description: Generates an INSERT SQL statement from a table name or recordset object and data array.

methods.name: _adodb_column_sql_oci8
methods.description: Handles BLOB and LONG data types in Oracle OCI8 driver during SQL statement creation.

methods.name: _adodb_column_sql
methods.description: Generates SQL snippets for setting column values, handling different data types across drivers.

methods.name: _adodb_column_sql
methods.description: Overloaded function to handle different data types and quoting depending on driver and type.

methods.name: _adodb_debug_execute
methods.description: Performs debug logging for executing SQL statements, outputting to browser or CLI.

methods.name: _adodb_backtrace
methods.description: Pretty-prints debug backtrace for debugging code execution flow.
